name: apache-incubator
description: Skills from the Apache Incubator for podlings, mentors and the IPMC.

plugins.name: releasecheck
plugins.description: Checks an Apache Incubator podling release candidate before or during its vote. Produces findings for a person to review, never a vote.

plugins.name: maturity-model-assessment
plugins.description: Builds an evidence pack for an Apache Incubator podling against the 38 items of the Apache Project Maturity Model, marking each evidenced, proxy or human. Never a score or verdict.

plugins.name: graduation-self-assessment
plugins.description: Compares the ipmc MCP's graduation-readiness verdict with what an Apache Incubator podling says in its own reports, checked against the mail archives.

plugins.name: graduation-packet-builder
plugins.description: Assembles an Apache Incubator podling's graduation case and drafts the DISCUSS email and the board resolution.

plugins.name: retirement-shepherd
plugins.description: Assesses whether a stalled Apache Incubator podling should retire and drafts the discussion, the announcement and the shutdown checklist.

plugins.name: monthly-report-review
plugins.description: The monthly IPMC report review: flags podlings that have not filed, cross-checks narratives against health data and drafts shepherd comments.

plugins.name: release-vote-reviewer
plugins.description: Walks an Apache Incubator release vote thread on general@ and drafts the +1 or the -1 with reasons.

plugins.name: board-report
plugins.description: Drafts the VP Incubator's quarterly report to the ASF board.

plugins.name: branding-sweep
plugins.description: Trademark and branding compliance check across all current Apache Incubator podlings, as a ranked fix list.

plugins.name: podling-onboarding
plugins.description: Reviews a new Apache Incubator podling's proposal against the checklist and bootstraps its tracking: SGA, ICLAs, infrastructure, first report date.

plugins.name: podling-name-clearance
plugins.description: Runs the Apache Incubator podling name search end to end and writes it up in the required format.
